bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
echo "SOURCE_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "SOURCE_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)"
echo "BOT_RUNNING=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"
echo "LIVE_BUNDLE_SHA=$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)"
echo "SOURCE_START_FILES:"
rg -l --glob '*.{ts,tsx,mjs,js}' 'start=|/start|startless' artifacts/bot/src | head -80
